modern: Everything material soon disappears into the substance of the whole; and every formal cause is very soon taken back into the universal reason; and the memory of everything is very soon overwhelmed in time.

explained.summary: Everything physical soon dissolves back into the material of the universe, every pattern or form is soon absorbed back into the reason that runs it, and every memory is soon buried by time. Marcus is setting out, plainly, how short-lived everything is, himself included.
